pages.text: Order contents supplied from more than one package, route the matching parts through the Re-packager, and let it emit the correctly combined shipment.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Collect order fragments in an inventory with a powered Re-Packager. Wait for all fragments and emit a combined package for predictable recipe delivery.
